CEO Greg Smith says more realisation opportunities lie ahead. hVIVO PLC (AIM:HVO) has posted a record order book of £72 million after its first pivotal Phase 3 trial with ILiAD. It's now targeting £47 million in full-year revenue, and CEO Mo Khan says the order book provides good visibility. Accesso Technology Group PLC (LSE:ACSO, OTC:LOQPF, FRA:LQG) has seen cash EBITDA jump almost 50% after tightening up its cost base. It's now betting big on its "AI first" accesso Intelligence platform. CEO Lee Cowie says accessoPay represents another opportunity. HeLIX Exploration PLC (AIM:HEX, OTCQB:HHEXF) has spudded the Ollie #1 well, testing the northern extension of its Rudyard helium field in Montana. CEO Bo Sears highlighted the presence of multiple stacked pays at Rudyard, with the company examining every formation encountered. articles.title: Pan African Resources CEO: Record year sets up 'healthy' balance sheet for growth push
articles.summary: Pan African Resources PLC (LSE:PAF, OTCQX:PAFRY, JSE:PAN) CEO Cobus Loots spoke with Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about the company's record production and earnings for FY2026, production guidance for the year ahead, and growth opportunities across its South African and Australian operations. Loots said performance benefited from a stronger gold price and a 40% increase in production, reflecting a full year of output from Australia and Mogale Tailings Retreatment (MTR), alongside strong showings from Elikhulu, Evander and Barberton. The company has also strengthened its balance sheet, moving from net debt to what Loots described as a "really healthy cash balance." Looking ahead, Pan African is targeting production of around 280,000 to 300,000 ounces, with the South African portfolio expected to hold its performance alongside rising output from Tennant Mines. Loots also discussed the ramp-up at Tennant Mines and the potential of the White Devil deposit, calling it "one of the highest grading deposits in Australia" at around 3.5 grams per tonne, remaining open at depth and along strike. The interview also covers the Soweto Cluster DFS, pointing to potential production of 35,000-40,000 ounces annually subject to permitting, along with Loots' approach to balancing growth investment with shareholder returns and key milestones for the coming 12 months, including production and cost guidance, MTR expansion, and exploration across the wider Tennant Goldfield. articles.title: Pan African Resources, EGT, Helix Exploration, Rockfire Resources, ATOME, Quadrise
articles.summary: Pan African Resources PLC (LSE:PAF, OTCQX:PAFRY, JSE:PAN) has reported a record year, with gold production up almost 40%. Earnings nearly tripled, and it's proposing a record final dividend. European Green Transition PLC (AIM:EGT) says its first half was a "transformational period" after completing its Wind Services acquisition. Its repowering orderbook now represents a potential £126 million opportunity. HeLIX Exploration PLC (AIM:HEX, OTCQB:HHEXF) has spudded the Ollie #1 at its Rudyard helium field in Montana. It's targeting the same formations that have already produced commercial-grade helium nearby. Rockfire Resources PLC (LSE:ROCK) has recorded its highest-ever silver reading at the Molaoi deposit in Greece. One zone came back at nearly 560 grams per tonne, a record for the project. ATOME PLC (AIM:ATOM) has secured options over more than 4,000 hectares in Paraguay for its planned solar plant. It's also opened a new front in Brazil, exploring a second green fertiliser project. Quadrise PLC (AIM:QED) says partner Valkor Technologies has begun drilling two new pilot wells at its Asphalt Ridge project in Utah.
